d: THE COLLISION IS A BRANDON SANDERSON FAN WIKI. "The Unmade" are named entities in the Stormlight Archive, and a 2017 theory thread about Cusicesh sits beside a Rebekah Cranes mandala.
reading:
THE ARCHIVE’S INTERNAL GRAPH COUNTS ARE SURFACED AS A DESCRIPTION. Card 1’s snippet is registry metadata — "2026-01-04 · #235 · DEFINES 19 · REFBY 10" — deposit number, concepts defined, inbound reference count. The archive’s own citation-graph statistics serving as the summary of a work. That is the interlinking apparatus of Phase F, visible in a card two months before the workplan proposed measuring it.

THE COLLISION IS FANDOM. "The Unmade" are named cosmic entities in Brandon Sanderson’s Stormlight Archive, and card 5 is a 17th Shard theory thread from 2017 about Cusicesh imprisoning one. A fan-wiki reading of a fictional cosmology, beside a mandala "authored under Rebekah Cranes and the Institute for Diagrammatic Poetics".

Card 2 also carries the thesis at full strength — "The death drive has been SEMANTICALLY LIQUIDATED" — through the same Academia topic page, "Death Drive Research Papers", that appeared in the «"semiotic death drive"» capture on the same day. The category page is the recurring route.
analysis: As screenshotted: *a 7,156-word theoretical text and associated mandala-style visual schema... authored by Dr. Orin Trace and Johannes Sigil within the Alexanarch repository and Crimson Hexagonal Archive* — word count exact to the digit, dual authorship correct, schema paired to text. As transcribed after regeneration: the same attribution with the visual line extended to *created under the Institute for Diagrammatic Poetics*, and a Core Concepts triad reading sign-failure, traumatic repetition, and symbolic breakdown as structural elements. The organic set completes the third credit: the Visual Schema record *authored under Rebekah Cranes and the Institute for Diagrammatic...* — text to Trace/Sigil, schema to Cranes, exactly the division the deposits declare. The Academia snippet supplies the liquidation thesis under the orthonym (*The death drive has been semantically liquidated*). Autocorrect pressure (*alexander unmade sign*) overridden; a 17th Shard Stormlight *Unmade* thread sits at the set’s floor as fandom-lexical bleed. Regeneration pair preserved. Session pair: `semiotic-death-drive-recapture-20260811`, captured 8 minutes earlier — the theory query and the work query, cross-citing.
